mr.title: Reject empty import payloads and skip duplicate SKUs

summary.intent: Make POST /api/imports reject empty or malformed payloads and stop creating duplicate rows for an existing SKU.
summary.approach: Validation moves into ImportRequest and ImportService returns imported/skipped counts.

blocks.what: ImportRequest requires a non-empty rows array with sku and qty per row; the controller answers 201 with counts.
blocks.why: The PR description asks for empty payloads to be rejected.

blocks.what: run() returns an ImportResult, enforces a row cap and skips existing SKUs.
blocks.why: Unclear: the PR does not say why the cap was added.

blocks.what: Route throttle, max_rows config key, two feature tests and a brick/math dependency.
blocks.why: Supports the import changes; the dependency is not used anywhere in the diff.
